description: Use when you already have an https URL and need its text as clean Markdown (title, headings, links). Not a web search and not a token check. $0.004 per call via x402 on GET /read?url=. No free daily check. maxChars defaults to 20000 (allowed 1000-100000); if the Markdown is longer it is cut at that limit and truncated=true. Non-https URLs are rejected and not charged. Invalid or failed calls are not charged. With no payment, the tool returns error=payment_required and the x402 Payment Required challenge for the HTTP route; pay that USDC amount, then retry the URL.

maxChars.description: max markdown chars (default 20000, min 1000, max 100000). Longer text is cut and truncated=true

url.description: https URL to read; non-https is rejected and not charged

name: read_page

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

truncated.description: true when markdown was cut at maxChars or the fetch was size-capped

title: Read Web Page as Markdown
